description: This Kotlin source file defines the ImportExportViewModel class, which manages CSV import and export operations for a trading journal application. It provides observable properties for operation results and status messages, and handles asynchronous execution of database interactions via a thread executor.

classes.name: ImportExportViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for managing CSV import/export operations in the trading journal app, encapsulating the logic and UI data for the import/export screen.

methods.name: exportTrades
methods.description: Exports all trades to a CSV string asynchronously, updating observable properties with results and status messages.

methods.name: importTrades
methods.description: Imports trades from given CSV content asynchronously, updating observable properties with the number of imported trades and status messages.

methods.name: deleteAllTrades
methods.description: Deletes all trade entries asynchronously, updating the status message accordingly.
